title: XNPV error lane: 175 of 175 #NUM! guard rows, on the structural axis
upstream_status_verbatim: identified by the W109 calculation-graph search, repaired, and signed off `1530/1530` numeric + `175/175` error rows
status_plain: 175 XNPV rows publish a typed error rather than a number, and the production kernel matched Excel's #NUM! on all 175. This is a guard sweep, not an arithmetic result: live Excel publishes #NUM! for rate = 0, for rate = -0.0, and for every negative rate probed, while +1e-300 evaluates. Matching an error placement is the structural-admission axis, not the numeric-bits axis. Recording these 175 rows on the numeric axis, as the earlier harvest did by adding them to 1,530, both fabricates a figure and leaves XNPV reading as having no structural comparison record when it holds an error-lane sign-off.
